Coordinate systems

Source: R/coordinate_systems.R, R/zz_constructors.R
coordinate_systems.Rd

Axes() draws an x and a y NumberLine() that cross at the origin of the coordinates. ThreeDAxes() adds a z axis. NumberPlane() adds a grid of background lines, PolarPlane() a polar grid, and ComplexPlane() a plane addressed by complex numbers.

Usage

Axes(
  x_range = NULL,
  y_range = NULL,
  x_length = round(frame_width()) - 2,
  y_length = round(frame_height()) - 2,
  axis_config = NULL,
  x_axis_config = NULL,
  y_axis_config = NULL,
  tips = TRUE,
  ...
)

ThreeDAxes(
  x_range = c(-6, 6, 1),
  y_range = c(-5, 5, 1),
  z_range = c(-4, 4, 1),
  x_length = frame_height() + 2.5,
  y_length = frame_height() + 2.5,
  z_length = frame_height() - 1.5,
  z_axis_config = NULL,
  z_normal = DOWN,
  num_axis_pieces = 20,
  light_source = 9 * DOWN + 7 * LEFT + 10 * OUT,
  depth = NULL,
  gloss = 0.5,
  ...
)

NumberPlane(
  x_range = c(-frame_x_radius(), frame_x_radius(), 1),
  y_range = c(-frame_y_radius(), frame_y_radius(), 1),
  x_length = NULL,
  y_length = NULL,
  background_line_style = NULL,
  faded_line_style = NULL,
  faded_line_ratio = 1,
  make_smooth_after_applying_functions = TRUE,
  axis_config = NULL,
  y_axis_config = NULL,
  ...
)

PolarPlane(
  radius_max = frame_y_radius(),
  size = NULL,
  radius_step = 1,
  azimuth_step = NULL,
  azimuth_units = "PI radians",
  azimuth_compact_fraction = TRUE,
  azimuth_offset = 0,
  azimuth_direction = "CCW",
  azimuth_label_buff = SMALL_BUFF,
  azimuth_label_font_size = 24,
  radius_config = NULL,
  background_line_style = NULL,
  faded_line_style = NULL,
  faded_line_ratio = 1,
  make_smooth_after_applying_functions = TRUE,
  ...
)

ComplexPlane(
  x_range = c(-frame_x_radius(), frame_x_radius(), 1),
  y_range = c(-frame_y_radius(), frame_y_radius(), 1),
  x_length = NULL,
  y_length = NULL,
  background_line_style = NULL,
  faded_line_style = NULL,
  faded_line_ratio = 1,
  make_smooth_after_applying_functions = TRUE,
  axis_config = NULL,
  y_axis_config = NULL,
  ...
)

CoordinateSystem(
  x_range = NULL,
  y_range = NULL,
  x_length = NULL,
  y_length = NULL,
  dimension = 2,
  ...
)

Arguments

x_range, y_range, z_range

c(min, max, step) of each axis.

x_length, y_length, z_length

Lengths of the axes.

axis_config, x_axis_config, y_axis_config, z_axis_config

Lists of arguments for the NumberLine() of every axis or of one axis.

tips

Whether the axes get arrow tips.

...

Passed to VGroup() (style).

z_normal

Direction the z axis is rotated toward before tilting.

num_axis_pieces

Number of pieces each axis is cut into for 3D depth sorting.

light_source

Light direction; every axis piece has a sheen of 0.2 along it.

depth, gloss

Unused; kept for compatibility.

background_line_style

List of style arguments for the grid lines.

faded_line_style

Style of the faded lines; defaults to a halved background_line_style.

faded_line_ratio

Number of faded lines per grid cell.

make_smooth_after_applying_functions

Accepted for compatibility; upstream's VMobject initializer resets it to FALSE, so it has no effect.

radius_max

Largest radius drawn.

size

Diameter of the plane; NULL means one unit per radius step.

radius_step

Spacing of the circles.

azimuth_step

Number of radial lines (or the angle units per line).

azimuth_units

One of "PI radians", "TAU radians", "degrees", "gradians" or NULL.

azimuth_compact_fraction

Whether to write labels like \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) instead of \(\frac{1}{4}\pi\).

azimuth_offset

Angle of the first radial line.

azimuth_direction

"CCW" or "CW".

azimuth_label_buff, azimuth_label_font_size

Azimuth label layout.

radius_config

List of arguments for the radius NumberLine().

dimension

Number of axes of a coordinate system, 2 or 3.

Value

A coordinate system mobject.

Details

All coordinate systems share these methods (CoordinateSystemClass): coords_to_point() (alias c2p), point_to_coords() (alias p2c), polar_to_point() (pr2pt), point_to_polar() (pt2pr), get_axis(i) (1 based), get_x_axis(), get_y_axis(), get_z_axis(), get_origin(), get_x_axis_label(), get_y_axis_label(), get_axis_labels(), add_coordinates(), plot(), plot_implicit_curve(), plot_parametric_curve(), plot_polar_graph(), plot_surface(), plot_derivative_graph(), plot_antiderivative_graph(), input_to_graph_point() (i2gp), input_to_graph_coords() (i2gc), get_graph_label(), get_riemann_rectangles(), get_area(), angle_of_tangent(), slope_of_tangent(), get_secant_slope_group(), get_vertical_line(), get_horizontal_line(), get_lines_to_point(), get_vertical_lines_to_graph() and get_T_label(). Axes adds plot_line_graph().

Shapes follow upstream: c2p(x, y) with numbers, or c2p(c(x, y)), returns one point; c2p(m) with an n x k matrix whose rows are coordinates returns an n x 3 matrix of points; c2p(xs, ys) with vectors returns a 3 x n matrix (rows x, y, z). p2c() returns a vector for one point and an n x d matrix for an n x 3 matrix of points.

Differences from Python: the point function of a graph is graph$func (function is reserved in R); axis indices and colorscale_axis are 1 based; dictionaries become lists named by the numeric positions, for example list("1" = "a", "2" = "b").

Examples

ax <- Axes(x_range = c(-3, 3), y_range = c(-2, 2))
g <- ax$plot(sin, color = BLUE)
area <- ax$get_area(g, x_range = c(0, 2))
plane <- NumberPlane()
